[liquid_glass_widgets] LiquidGlassBlendGroup could not find an InheritedGeometryRenderLink in the widget tree.

This happens when GlassQuality.premium is used outside of a LiquidGlassLayer (or AdaptiveLiquidGlassLayer).

To fix this, either:
  • Wrap the widget in a LiquidGlassLayer / AdaptiveLiquidGlassLayer, OR
  • Set useOwnLayer: true on your GlassButton / AdaptiveGlass, which provisions its own layer automatically.

Example:
  GlassButton(
    quality: GlassQuality.premium,
    useOwnLayer: true, // ← add this
    ...
  )
A GlassContentAwareScope supports a single GlassContentAwareContent. Found a second content region under the same scope.
Either title or child must be provided
Either trigger or triggerBuilder must be provided
GlassAdaptiveScopeData.of() was called on a context that does not have a GlassAdaptiveScope ancestor. Make sure GlassAdaptiveScope is placed above this widget in the tree.

GlassBarItem.spacer() is not rendered yet: a run of items renders as a single glass capsule. Splitting a run with a spacer is a follow-up; GlassBarItemBackground.separate already gives one item its own shell.

GlassContainer: `settings` provided without `useOwnLayer: true`. In grouped mode, per-widget settings are ignored — the parent layer's settings are used instead.
  → To apply these settings, add `useOwnLayer: true` (creates a separate rendering layer).
  → For better performance, set `settings` on GlassPage or AdaptiveLiquidGlassLayer so all grouped children inherit them.
GlassModalSheet needs at least one detent — add medium and/or large (small alone is a floor, not a resting height).
GlassModalSheet.show() needs at least one detent — add medium and/or large (small alone is a floor, not a resting height).

GlassModalSheet.show(morphFrom:) needs a GlassMorphAnchor whose GlassMorphTrigger is mounted and laid out. It was not on screen when show() was called — pass morphFromRect if the trigger has no render box of its own.
GlassModalSheetScaffold needs at least one detent — add medium and/or large (small alone is a floor, not a resting height).
GlassSegment must have either an icon or a label.
GlassSegmentedControl works best with 2–5 segments. For 6+ items use GlassSegmentedControl.scrollable().
GlassTab must have either an icon or label
Grid must have at least 1 cell
